Name: Bountiful Beauties Vol. 2 - Mud's Skimpy Anime Portraits (Bachelor Genderswaps)
Author: TheMud
Description:
[color=#ffff00][size=4]!!WARNING!! If the image previews didn't already make it abundantly clear, this mod page is home to scandalously tiny outfits and female bosoms of somewhat exaggerated size. If that's not something you wish to see more of, please turn back now.[/size][/color]


[size=3]This is the second volume of my skimpy NPC portrait and sprite overhaul mod, now aimed at reimagining the six bachelors! As with the first volume, this mod utilizes Dialogue Display Framework Continued to present all-new hand-drawn portraits, with more emphasis to the character art, with poses and expressions for every portrait!

NOTE: Be sure to read the [color=#ff7700]Compatibility[/color] section! Because this mod uses frameworks that change the way the game displays character art, there are a number of potential mod conflicts, the drastic overhauls to the characters' appearances means that compatibility with other mods is not guaranteed.[/size]

For Volume I, featuring the original six ladies of Stardew, click here:

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29979][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/thumbnails/29979/29979-1734428860-1992684810.png[/img]
[/url][size=5][u][color=#ffff00][center][b]Requirements[/b][/center][/color][/u]
[/size][size=3]This mod is made with [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22678?tab=description]Dialogue Display Framework Continued[/url][size=3] for the portrait component and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36813]Scale Up Unofficial[/url][/size][size=3] for the sprites.[/size][size=3] [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][size=3] is recommended to access the optional appearance toggles included for summer swimsuits and all-day usage of Joja work uniforms.[/size]

[center][color=#ff7700][size=5][b][u]Installation[/u][/b][/size][/color][/center]
[size=3]Install SMAPI, then get all of the mods this mod depends on: Content Patcher, Dialogue Display Framework Continued, and Scale Up Unofficial. Place all folders for these mods in your Mods folder.

If you are playing in English or Spanish and want to change the bachelors' in-game names and pronouns, install Change Dialogues by mardrest (not Dialogue Changes by Invatorzen). Go into its config menu with GMCM, and set the display options for the bachelors to "Other" instead of "Vanilla", and restart the game to get the setting to take effect.[/size]

[size=5][u][center][b][color=#00ffff]The Content[/color][/b][/center][/u][/size]
[size=3]This isn't the first mod that changes the guys of Stardew into girls, but they've certainly never been seen like this! Sam, Sebastian, Harvey, Shane, Elliott, and Alex are now Samantha, Sabrina, Harriet, Shauna, Elliette, and... uhh... Alex! Presenting...[/size]

[size=5][u][center][b][color=#ff7700]﻿Compatibility and Known Issues[/color][/b][/center]
[/u][/size]﻿
[list]
[*] ﻿This mod is unsurprisingly incompatible with any other mod that changes the bachelors' appearances. This includes any outfit mods but also NSFW mods that may use the original male appearances of the characters. I do not currently plan to add compatibility for any such mod conflicts but do have plans for more original content featuring my designs in the future!
[*] ﻿Dialogue mods should still work but dialogue will still refer to them by their original names and pronouns. English and Spanish-speaking users can try [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5335]Change Dialogues by mardrest[/url] which allows you to set your own name and gender settings for every character in the game using GMCM, with patches for numerous dialogue mods such as SVE! [b]NOTE: Change Dialogues config should be set to "Other" for Portrait options on the bachelors, and the game must be restarted for config changes to take effect.[/b]﻿
[*] ﻿This mod was configured for 100% UI Scale at 1920x1080 resolution, if the dialogue does not fit your game screen try changing the UI Scale option or your game resolution in the game settings.
[/list]﻿
